sections.title: Test Coverage Analysis
sections.content:
I ran `bun test --coverage` against the files in scope rather than eyeballing the pasted snippets, since two of the truncated test files contain comments claiming certain gaps that turned out to be stale. Findings below are verified against the actual coverage tool output and current file contents, not the (partial) context.

★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────
Two of the pasted test files (`SketchBarChart.test.tsx`, and comments in `Sketch.test.ts`/`ResearchActivity.test.ts`) assert that React-hook components "cannot be tested without a DOM" or are "awaiting @testing-library/react setup." That's no longer true — `test/setup.ts` already registers `happy-dom` + RTL, and `sketch-components-dom.test.tsx` / `research-activity-dom.test.tsx` already render and interact with these exact components. This is why I ran the coverage tool instead of trusting comments: stale gap-documentation is itself a coverage risk, because it tells the next engineer "don't bother" about something that's already solved.
─────────────────────────────────────────────────

`moat-vis.ts` and `agent-vocabulary.ts` initially showed low coverage in a scoped run — that was an artifact of only loading a subset of test files (they're transitively imported). Re-running each against its **own** test file shows `moat-vis.ts` is fully covered; `agent-vocabulary.ts` is not — that's a real gap (see below).

---

sections.title: Gap 1 — `agent-vocabulary.ts`: ~15 exported functions have no direct unit test (highest priority)
Gap 2 — `FigmaEmbed.ts`: `parseHTML().getAttrs` is untested (confirmed uncovered, lines 39-44)
Gap 3 — `SketchBarChart.test.tsx`: stale gap-documentation, not an actual gap (fix by pruning)
Gap 4 (minor) — `decisions-shared.test.ts`: `displayWho("")` assertion doesn't assert behavior
Not a gap, for the record
sections.content:
- `moat-vis.ts` (100% own-file coverage), `format.ts`, `ranking.ts`, `incident-format.ts`, `graph-visual.ts`, `decisions-shared.ts` (aside from Gap 4) — all fully exercised, including branch/tie-break/edge cases (future timestamps, malformed ISO strings, empty arrays, zero/negative counts).
- Sketch and ResearchActivity React components — rendering, hover/focus, null-render branches, and the race-guard hover/blur logic are all covered by the `*-dom.test.tsx` files; the pasted context just didn't include them.

Want me to write these as actual files (agent-vocabulary additions, the FigmaEmbed `getAttrs` tests, and the SketchBarChart cleanup), or leave this as the report?
